language.heading: Language
language.description: Choose the language for the interface and for newly generated interview/report content.

theme.heading: Appearance
theme.description: Choose whether the interface uses the light or dark theme. Your choice is remembered in this browser.

cv.heading: CV profile
cv.description: Upload your CV once and new interviews are personalised from it automatically. The file itself is not stored, only the text extracted from it.
cv.uploadFailed: Could not upload the CV. Please try again.
cv.removeFailed: Could not remove the CV. Please try again.

deleteAccount.heading: Delete account
deleteAccount.description: Your account is permanently deleted along with your interviews, pre-assessments and reports. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.dialogTitle: You are about to permanently delete your account
deleteAccount.dialogDescription: Your account and all interview/pre-assessment records will be removed from the database. This cannot be undone and you will not be able to sign in with the same credentials again.
deleteAccount.confirmLabel: I understand this action cannot be undone.

errors.notConfirmed: Tick the confirmation box to continue.
errors.forbidden: Administrator accounts cannot be deleted from this screen.
errors.generic: The account could not be deleted. Please try again.
